children: US net lease REIT's Q3 revenue declined yr/yr, reflecting asset dispositions
Q3 adjusted FFO per share declined yr/yr
Company completed $535 mln Modiv Industrial acquisition and integrated portfolio
Company raises full-year 2026 AFFO per share guidance to $0.83 – $0.85
Company raises full-year 2026 gross transaction volume guidance to $750 mln – $800 mln
Company reaffirms 2026 net debt to adjusted EBITDA guidance of 6.5x – 6.9x

MODIV ACQUISITION - Co said Modiv Industrial acquisition increased industrial exposure and extended average lease term
G&A SAVINGS - Co said annualized G&A expense declined yr/yr due to portfolio simplification and operational efficiencies
